purpose: Re-examine official multi-source availability and evidence above the existing CHAOS campaign without replacing prior artifacts or rerunning prior locked experiments
browser_context: My Browser connected; pages and official URLs reviewed for provenance and current access paths

source_tracks.requirement: source-defined institutional or regulatory observations; no leader/party causal labels

reuse_policy: Previous baseline, schemas, ledgers, evidence, rejected edges and raw provenance remain immutable references; new artifacts are versioned under this round
admission_policy: Only supported_predictive TransitionEvidence can enter positive composition; descriptive, rejected, unresolved and not_testable remain quarantined
frequency_policy: Preserve native annual/monthly/daily/event frequencies; no implicit annualization
transformation_policy: No imputation, source averaging, forced reconciliation, log, normalization or hidden differencing in source extraction
